caseName: Norman Breaux Lumber Co. v. Reed
caseNameFull: Norman Breaux Lumber Co. v. Reed, Tax Collector of Adams County, Mississippi, and his successor in office
attorneys: Mr. L. T. Kennedy for defendant in error and appellee in support of the motion., Mr. R. C. Milling for plaintiff in error and appellant, in opposition thereto. < .

opinions.text:
Pet Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted for the reason that the judgment of the state court sought here to be reviewed was based on a non-federal ground adequate to support it. Bilby v. Stewart, 246 U. S. 255, 257; Farson, Son & Co. v. Bird, 248 U. S. 268, 271.
